integrity: The theorem uses an analytical proof and an independent exact-integer finite verifier for small instances; enumeration is not used as proof for unbounded profiles.
scientific_limitations: Positive result requires DR feasibility, applies only to k=1,2. Counterexample for k=3 has n=3,m=5 and candidate-interval approvals; its voter count is not claimed minimal. No approximation or higher-seat classification is proved.
title: Sharp two-seat exactness of local distinctive representation and a three-seat interval obstruction
